scope: Mod原创物品与装备的细粒度登记：名称、来源、游戏风格描述（中英）、处置规则。描述口径参照原作样例（来源地/用途/行业视角，1-2句，≤约60字），不复制原作文本。
style_rules: 1-2句为主，最多3句；总长≤约60字；不写抽象赞美与感叹堆砌。
落在世界事实上：来源地、用途、行业惯例、谁在用；允许一处冷幽默或意外发现。
不暴露后台标识（N#/resolve/paid等）；不承诺无限供给或永久效果。
与既有NPC/任务文案同语气：短句、具体物件、生活视角；英译保持同义克制。
名称给稳定中英对照；英译供本地化参考，不逐字硬译、不冒称与原作译名对齐。
不写数值与效果承诺（价格、耐久、加成均待实机校准）；描述只谈来源、用途与处置。

terminology_alignment.note_cn: 通用词一致；模组不新增替代药膏的疗伤体系。

terminology_alignment.mod_usage: 布带、护腕（多处护理场景）
terminology_alignment.note_cn: 官方用「绷带」；模组「布带」指更宽的包扎布，避免与官方绷带道具混同。
官方「夹板」是医疗固定具；模组「支具」是长期佩戴的腿部支撑，「支架」是器械支架，三者不互换。
模组护符为旧物，不附魔法效果。
用法一致；模组钥匙不绕过原生门锁与保存。
官方「契据」指委托契约；模组「工约/短单」是雇佣与交接文书，不占契据系统。
官方强调身份戒指；模组用「印」指工作印鉴，不作政治身份。
吹法与用途本地化，词形一致。
「炭」为常用简写；不改变原炭场背景。
模组书信走原生背包与阅读流程，不冒称任务书信道具。

terminology_alignment.mod_usage: 仿制纪念章（RAT-02）、纪念章修工
terminology_alignment.note_cn: STRG中文段无「纪念章」命中；为模组原创物件，避免与官方勋章体系混同。
无官方词形命中；模组按「原件/副件」自定规则，不新增通用票据系统。

terminology_alignment.mod_usage: 有限中立支架（HIG-02）、旧量样支具
terminology_alignment.note_cn: 器械词为模组原创；与官方「夹板」区分见上。

terminology_alignment.mod_usage: 矿灯、织机、铭牌、绳索（多处场景物）
terminology_alignment.note_cn: STRG中文段未见对应词形；按普通物件处理，若未来原版新增同名词条再复核。

items.desc_cn: 工营办事员留的一联存根，泥印未干就被叠起。它只证明那天谁在堤上受伤，不证明人还活着。
items.desc_en: A counterfoil kept by the work-camp clerk, folded while the mud stamp was still wet. It proves who was hurt on the dike that day — not that they are alive.
items.rules_cn: 原件交出后不留副件；补领只复核同一登记事实，不复制奖励或新授权。
items.rules_en: No copy stays behind once the original is handed over; re-issuing only re-checks the same logged fact.

items.desc_cn: 她把自己改过的栏目写成自述，封蜡上按了指印。字是她写的，责任也是；封存不等于免责。
items.desc_en: She wrote down the columns she had altered and sealed it with her thumbprint. The words are hers, and so is the blame; sealing is not absolution.
items.rules_cn: 启封须本人到场；缺场时只由中立柜转述已登记范围，不演死者新句。
items.rules_en: Unsealing needs her presence; absence lets only a neutral clerk read the logged scope.

items.desc_cn: 正面是欠额，背面是空白。肯在背面写字的人，等于把自己的名字押在了别人的债上。
items.desc_en: The face carries the debt; the reverse is blank. Whoever writes there is staking their name on someone else's debt.
items.rules_cn: 玩家签名一旦实际登记即留痕；撤保、停追与补偿分项核，付一笔钱不自动清除担保。
items.rules_en: A player signature stays on record once filed; withdrawal, stay of pursuit and compensation are checked separately.

items.name_cn: 停止转运请求及收讫附联
items.desc_cn: 请求联与收讫联本该一起走；有人只带了一半，说另一半在雨里丢了。两联对不上，停运就还差一步。
items.desc_en: Request and counterfoil should travel together; someone brought only one half and blamed the rain. Until they match, the stop is one step short.
items.rules_cn: 只凭单联不结案；缺联用现场双记号复核，不补造第二份原件。
items.rules_en: One half never closes the case; a missing half is verified by twin on-site marks, never fabricated.

items.desc_cn: 两个人的疗程并排誊在一页上，姓名栏被剪掉。配对是为了比对反应，不是为了替谁证明疼痛更少。
items.desc_en: Two courses of treatment sit side by side on one page, names clipped out. The pairing compares reactions — it does not rank anyone's pain.
items.rules_cn: 脱敏页只作范围核对；本人姓名与病史分别授权，不因治疗关系自动互通。
items.rules_en: The redacted page scopes only; names and histories need separate consent.

items.desc_cn: 标签上写着取水日期、点位和取的人。水样早就不在瓶里了，标签上的那一笔还作数。
items.desc_en: The tag records date, spot and who drew it. The water is long gone; the line written on the tag still counts.
items.rules_cn: 标签与取样记录同核；标签单独出现不升级证据等级。
items.rules_en: Tag and sampling record are checked together; a lone tag upgrades nothing.

items.desc_cn: 两版摘要并排，差的那一行用细笔改过。改笔的人以为涂掉就够了，纸背面还透得出原文。
items.desc_en: Two summaries side by side, one line retouched in fine ink. The editor thought erasure sufficed; the reverse still shows the original.
items.rules_cn: 对页比对须两版来源均登记；不凭一页宣判全库真伪。
items.rules_en: Both versions need logged provenance; one page never judges the whole archive.

items.name_cn: 葛文涅尔井中研究留稿
items.desc_cn: 留在井边的手稿，边角被潮气泡皱。有些页在讲方法，有些页在讲他自己；两部分不能当同一份证词。
items.desc_en: A draft left by the well, edges swollen with damp. Some pages discuss method, others discuss himself; the two are not one testimony.
items.rules_cn: 人身与协作分开记录；死亡时固定原稿仍可核方法，不补造本人新同意。
items.rules_en: Person and cooperation are recorded separately; the fixed draft outlives absence.

items.desc_cn: 条款把赔什么、护理谁、谁签字分成三栏。私了只能填一栏，公共资格在另外两栏里。
items.desc_en: The terms split compensation, care and signature into three columns. A private settlement fills one; public standing lives in the other two.
items.rules_cn: 私了不给公共资格；补监督须另立修订，不回写原方案。
items.rules_en: Private settlement grants no public standing; late supervision needs a separate amendment.

items.desc_cn: 协议写明了三次读数、复测间隔和谁有权喊停。纸上每一步都清楚，做起来每一步都要人守。
items.desc_en: The protocol lists three readings, the re-test interval and who may call a stop. Every step is clear on paper and staffed in practice.
items.rules_cn: 三读数与复测实际完成才认证；回声与传闻不作协议依据。
items.rules_en: Certification needs the actual three readings and re-test; echoes and rumours never count.

items.desc_cn: 回执上留了托管方与监督方的空位。空位不是谦让，是谁都要先答一遍自己肯担什么。
items.desc_en: The receipt leaves blanks for custodian and supervisor. The blanks are not modesty — each side must first say what it will carry.
items.rules_cn: 资格按N13/N15/NE原条件独立核；资金与监督分开，不买责任。
items.rules_en: Eligibility follows the original conditions; funding never buys accountability.

items.desc_cn: 信里没写结局，只写谁还没拿到答复。她说编绳的活还在继续，你不必每天回来才算数。
items.desc_en: The letter holds no ending — only who still waits for an answer. The rope work continues; coming back daily is not the price of counting.
items.rules_cn: 回访一次登记一次；不因重读重发奖励或改变终局快照。
items.rules_en: One visit, one log; rereading re-issues nothing and never reopens the snapshot.

items.desc_cn: 摘记只抄了价目和趟数，船名一栏空着。空着不是漏抄，是那晚谁也不肯把名字写上去。
items.desc_en: Only prices and trips were copied; the vessel-name column stays empty. Not an oversight — nobody would write a name that night.
items.rules_cn: 运费与身份分开核；摘记不证明夜船原设定货物。
items.rules_en: Freight and identity are checked apart; the extract never proves the original night-boat mystery.

items.desc_cn: 图上画了三枚扣的孔位，中间那枚被涂改过。涂改的痕迹比孔更清楚。
items.desc_en: Three buckles' holes are drawn; the middle one was altered. The alteration reads clearer than the hole.
items.rules_cn: 只保实测批次；族属与一张旧检单不替代当下核验。
items.rules_en: Only tested batches hold; kinship and an old slip never replace present checks.

items.desc_cn: 短图画了订线的走法，页边标着‘原页’与‘后添’。标得清楚，才轮得到谈归谁。
items.desc_en: The chart shows the stitching path and marks 'original' against 'added'. Only clear labels let ownership be discussed.
items.rules_cn: 原页链、披露权、认证权分开；沉默不视为任人补名。
items.rules_en: Chain, disclosure and certification stay apart; silence never invites a fill-in.

items.desc_cn: 记号画到危险段就停，旁边写着‘封’。停下来也是结果，不必把它说成没办成。
items.desc_en: The marks stop at the unsafe stretch, with 'sealed' beside them. Stopping is an outcome — it need not be spun as failure.
items.rules_cn: 封棚与试走各自记录；家属误认与原案分开，不借公告替人下结论。
items.rules_en: Sealing and trial walks are logged separately; family guesses stay apart from the old case.

items.desc_cn: 短单列了首款、垫款和经手费三栏。三栏都填齐的人还没出现，但栏已经分好了。
items.desc_en: The slip lists advance, float and handling fee in three columns. Nobody has filled all three yet; the columns are ready.
items.rules_cn: 实际领款、旧余欠、垫款与再受雇分项；不拿一份短单替人答三次。
items.rules_en: Payout, arrears, float and re-hiring stay itemised; one slip never answers three questions.

items.desc_cn: 每项后面都留着签字格。空格不是等谁来代签，是等本人自己决定要不要填。
items.desc_en: Each item ends in a signature box. Empty boxes wait for the person concerned, not for a proxy.
items.rules_cn: 缺席者由记录人照读预先限定陈述；不设替身，不演全城一致祝捷。
items.rules_en: Absentees get their pre-scoped statement read aloud; no stand-ins, no unanimous finale.

items.desc_cn: 信纸对折过三次，边角磨白。送出之后原件不留背包，想念的人也得学着空手。
items.desc_en: The sheet was folded thrice, corners worn pale. Once sent, no original stays in the pack; even the sender learns to keep empty hands.
items.rules_cn: 原件实际投递后离包；只有本人准副件可留，重读不推进任务。
items.rules_en: The original leaves the pack on real delivery; only a permitted copy stays, and rereading advances nothing.

items.desc_cn: 副件抄了正文，落款处标着‘经本人准许’。它可以留，但不能当原件用第二次。
items.desc_en: The copy carries the text and the note 'by leave of the writer'. It may stay — it may not serve as a second original.
items.rules_cn: 副件仅作本人准许范围；口信路线不强制纸件，口信须真实接收人。
items.rules_en: The copy covers only consented scope; the oral route forces no paper and needs a real receiver.

items.desc_cn: 短记写着两件物件的名字，柜底不在范围里。取物不放弃旧屋的门，这两件事从来分开。
items.desc_en: Two objects are named; the cabinet bottom is out of scope. Retrieval never trades away the old room's door.
items.rules_cn: 限权代取须本人新授权；屋权争议另记，不凭一纸解除。
items.rules_en: Proxy retrieval needs fresh leave; the housing dispute is logged apart.

items.desc_cn: 短记只写本班到岗的人和时段。奥娅歇的是这一班，不是以后每一班都被谁代签了。
items.desc_en: The note logs this shift's staff and hours. Oya rests from this one shift — not from every shift to come.
items.rules_cn: 逐班问、逐人签；护理不是研究许可，工时只占一次。
items.rules_en: Shift by shift, person by person; care is not research consent and hours count once.

items.desc_cn: 两只柜子的钥匙挂在一起，账却各记各的。拒绝观察的人，碗里的水不会因此少一勺。
items.desc_en: The two cabinets hang from one key ring, but the ledgers stay separate. Refusing observation never costs a spoon of water.
items.rules_cn: 观察与普通分配实际拆开；旧诱导记录留史，不认证NE或救济。
items.rules_en: Observation and ordinary shares are truly split; old inducement stays on record.

items.desc_cn: 短记标的是本段捷径和一条外道。钱到账才谈撤牌，梁裂不裂从不看钱。
items.desc_en: The note marks this shortcut and one outer path. Money is discussed only after arrival; whether the beam is cracked never consults the purse.
items.rules_cn: 未到账不先开；绕行保持，普通通路不成维修循环。
items.rules_en: No opening before arrival; the bypass stays and no repair loop forms.

items.desc_cn: 原数和补笔分成两栏，补痕标了日期。修正看得见，误差才谈得上缩小。
items.desc_en: Readings and addendum sit in separate columns, the retouch dated. Visible corrections are the only way error shrinks.
items.rules_cn: 复测只限本仪表；支架非全山安全，改表不授NE5。
items.rules_en: Re-tests cover this instrument only; no mountain-wide claim, no certification by edit.

items.desc_cn: 工约和钥匙订在一起，旧薪与新约分栏。交回钥匙的人，没有交回自己以后愿不愿意。
items.desc_en: Contract and key are stapled together, old wages and new terms in separate columns. Returning a key never returns one's future willingness.
items.rules_cn: 只在最终冻结后触发；续约逐人问，旧欠独立结，缺交接保待办。
items.rules_en: Triggers only after the freeze; renewals are asked per person and handovers stay pending when missing.

items.desc_cn: 出师前用的试印，刻的是师傅的字号，不是自己的。留着一枚，也说明不了谁的手艺算数。
items.desc_en: A trial seal from before graduation, cut with the master's mark, not one's own. Keeping it never settles whose craft counts.
items.rules_cn: 署名与工钱分开核；旧案获得署名不买永久合作。
items.rules_en: Signature and wages are checked apart; an old case's credit buys no permanent tie.

items.desc_cn: 本地药房自己印的标纸，墨色深浅不一。同样的方子，换一张标纸就能多卖三成。
items.desc_en: Locally printed labels, ink uneven. The same recipe fetches three parts more under a different sheet.
items.rules_cn: 标签只证经手范围；私柜与患者用量另授权。
items.rules_en: Labels prove handling scope only; cabinets and dosages need separate leave.

items.desc_cn: 按旧量样做的腿部支具，皮带扣换过两次。响的是铁片，不是秘密。
items.desc_en: A leg brace built to an old measure, its buckles replaced twice. The rattle is iron — not a secret.
items.rules_cn: 支具无工资资格效果；隐名与费用隐瞒不是同一许可。
items.rules_en: The brace carries no wage claim; anonymity and fee concealment are different permissions.

items.desc_cn: 从报废批次里锯下来的断扣，孔位被人改过。谁改的孔、谁省了撑，都能从这一块看出来。
items.desc_en: A buckle sawn from a scrap batch, its hole altered. Who re-bored it and who skimped the brace both show on this block.
items.rules_cn: 只保实测批次；分责须指实物，族属不作担保。
items.rules_en: Only tested batches hold; blame points at objects, never at kin.

items.desc_cn: 订线外补上的半页，字迹比原页新。谁添的、谁准的，比内容更先要问。
items.desc_en: A half leaf added outside the stitching, its hand younger than the page. Who added it and who permitted it come before what it says.
items.rules_cn: 原物链、披露权、认证权拆开；私页不让听席读。
items.rules_en: Chain, disclosure and certification stay apart; private leaves are not read aloud.

items.desc_cn: 先摆出来的扣费盘旁边压着这张短单，字是‘按时、公平’。读到这一行的人，多半正在被扣。
items.desc_en: Pinned beside the deduction tray, the slip reads 'on time, fair'. Whoever reads it is usually the one being deducted.
items.rules_cn: 首款、余欠、垫款与再受雇分项；告示不代替实付。
items.rules_en: Advance, arrears, float and re-hiring stay itemised; a notice never replaces payment.

items.desc_cn: 返修衬布上的针脚比原来密，姓名绣在里侧。名字缝进去，不是缝给人看的。
items.desc_en: The repaired lining carries denser stitching and a name sewn inside. The name is stitched in — not stitched for show.
items.rules_cn: 私存与公开分项；来源与受准核验人留限权柜。
items.rules_en: Private keeping and publicity are separate; provenance stays in a limited cabinet.

items.name_en: A Gift That Fits Too Well
items.desc_cn: 礼甲量的是送的人想要的身形，不是收的人现在的身形。合身，有时是最轻的催促。
items.desc_en: The gift armour was fitted to the shape the giver wanted, not the one the receiver has. A perfect fit can be the softest push.
items.rules_cn: 礼与授权分开；收礼不自动接受试用或代言。
items.rules_en: Gift and mandate stay apart; accepting never auto-accepts a fitting or a testimonial.

items.desc_cn: 钉好的空箱贴着往布林的标签。箱里装什么不重要，重要的是谁来决定装什么。
items.desc_en: A nailed crate wears a Brynn tag. What goes inside matters less than who decides it.
items.rules_cn: 空箱不冒称进口许可；内容与货主逐项核。
items.rules_en: An empty crate claims no import licence; contents and owner are checked item by item.

items.desc_cn: 毯角缝过粗线，锅底有一圈磕痕。要取的人得先问，取物不等于把门也交出去。
items.desc_en: A coarse seam on the blanket's corner, a ring of dents on the pot. Ask before taking — retrieval is not the door.
items.rules_cn: 只准本人列的两件；私柜不翻，旧屋共住争议另记。
items.rules_en: Only the two listed items; cabinets stay shut and the old room's dispute stands apart.

items.desc_cn: 断口是割的，不是磨断的。结打得不像本地手法，但不像不等于别人家的罪。
items.desc_en: The cut is sliced, not worn. The knot is unlike local work — unlike is not another household's guilt.
items.rules_cn: 结法只作线索；定责须实物与经手人，不凭手法归族。
items.rules_en: Knot style is a lead only; blame needs objects and handlers, never kin.

items.desc_cn: 苗圃角落留下的最后一株，根上还带着原地的土。卖不卖是价钱问题，留不留是以后的问题。
items.desc_en: The last cutting in the nursery's corner, local soil still on the root. Selling is about price; keeping is about next year.
items.rules_cn: 交易只按实量；旧出口线不因一株复活。
items.rules_en: Trade follows actual stock; one cutting revives no old export line.

items.desc_cn: 拆自旧料堆的梁木，端头有锯口。能架一段桥，架不住一句‘永远够用’。
items.desc_en: A beam from the old stack, sawn at the end. It spans one bridge — never a promise of endless supply.
items.rules_cn: 梁数实点；已占用与在住人的不擅拆。
items.rules_en: Counted beams only; occupied and inhabited pieces stay untouched.

items.desc_cn: 护林岗的哨子，吹法和腔调是本地约好的。会吹不等于有资格巡林。
items.desc_en: The post's whistle, its calls agreed locally. Blowing it well is not licence to patrol.
items.rules_cn: 巡段隐私与停班分别核；匿名不等于零识别风险。
items.rules_en: Patrol privacy and stops are checked apart; anonymity is not zero risk.

items.desc_cn: 镀层掉了一半的锡杯，杯底有骑卫队的旧刻。用它喝酒的人，多半没骑过马。
items.desc_en: A tin cup half stripped of plating, an old rider's mark beneath. Most who drink from it have never sat a horse.
items.rules_cn: 旧骑卫与北疆石场分开；杯不证明任何现役身份。
items.rules_en: Old riders stay apart from the northern quarries; the cup proves no serving rank.

items.desc_cn: 瓶里沉着细砂，水色比下游清。清的是这一瓶，不是整条沟的账。
items.desc_en: Fine sand settles in the bottle; the water reads clearer than downstream. One bottle is clean — not the whole trench's ledger.
items.rules_cn: 水样与砂账分开；领款者可不接受未来无限排放。
items.rules_en: Sample and sand accounts stay apart; takers may refuse future open discharge.

items.desc_cn: 寄存柜里的无名画，画的是双门外的路。族史查不到，价钱却一直在涨。
items.desc_en: A nameless painting in the deposit cabinet, showing the road beyond the twin doors. No family record — yet the price keeps climbing.
items.rules_cn: 归属未核不擅售；拒买不伪成交，不生成官方族史。
items.rules_en: No sale without verified ownership; a refusal never fakes a deal or invents lineage.

items.desc_cn: 桶底刻着两个名字，先刻的被后刻的压住一半。桶是空的，名字还各自算数。
items.desc_en: Two names are cut in the base, the later half covering the first. The barrel is empty; both names still count.
items.rules_cn: 两名各有权利；代存与归属分开，桶不作证明。
items.rules_en: Both names hold rights; custody and ownership stay apart.

items.desc_cn: 两季的枝条扎成一把，标签上的年份被人描过。地是谁的，枝才归谁剪。
items.desc_en: Two seasons' cuttings tied as one, the tag's year retraced. The land decides whose shears the branch belongs to.
items.rules_cn: 各权利人限一季分收；失败损失真列，不改成全年预售。
items.rules_en: Each holder takes one season's share; losses are listed, never sold as year-round futures.

items.desc_cn: 三户共用的篱门钥匙，柄上缠了三种颜色的线。谁多拿一把，别家就得问。
items.desc_en: One gate key for three households, three colours of thread on its bow. An extra copy always raises a question.
items.rules_cn: 退出户只续一季；不以旧互助强续未来。
items.rules_en: A withdrawing household renews one season only; old mutual aid never binds the future.

items.desc_cn: 单子上井写在嫁妆栏里，像水也能装箱带走。井在地里，谁家用水都得先问。
items.desc_en: The well is listed under dowry, as if water could be crated. The well stands in the ground; anyone drawing from it still asks.
items.rules_cn: 井不随婚事过户；用水权逐户核，不替当事人答。
items.rules_en: The well never transfers with a marriage; water rights are checked per household.

items.desc_cn: 照旧章翻的模子，边缘的毛刺没修。仿的是图案，仿不出那年谁真的站在栅后。
items.desc_en: Cast from the old medal, burrs left on the rim. The pattern copies — the year and the people behind the fence do not.
items.rules_cn: 仿章不判全部旧史；旧兽已死，不复活卖第二遍。
items.rules_en: A copy judges no history; the old beast stays dead.

items.desc_cn: 炭背工班领预付款时按的指印，纸角有炭黑。款到没到，看的是这一角，不是许诺。
items.desc_en: The charcoal-backed crew's thumbprint, corner smudged black. Whether the advance arrived is read on this corner — not in promises.
items.rules_cn: 预付款实际结清到人；赎金款不折声望积分。
items.rules_en: Advances settle to the person; ransom money never converts to standing points.

items.desc_cn: 粗铜打的护身符，正面是炉纹，背面刻过名字又被磨平。旧愿不因磨平就作数。
items.desc_en: A rough copper charm, forge-mark front, a name cut and smoothed on the back. Smoothing never honours an old vow.
items.rules_cn: 护符只作旧物；不代替赎金、许可或免责。
items.rules_en: The charm is an old object only; it replaces no ransom, licence or pardon.

items.desc_cn: 捆绳扎了双结，标签写着‘冬底’。外售只动没占的那部分，已承诺的得先留着。
items.desc_en: Double-knotted twine, the tag reading 'winter bottom'. Only unclaimed stock may be sold; promises stay aside first.
items.rules_cn: 已承诺底料实际保留；违约款按真实资产办，欠留欠。
items.rules_en: Promised stock is truly reserved; breach sums follow real assets and debts stay debts.

items.desc_cn: 染缸边挂的色样布，从浅到深共四块。水里的颜色进了布，堰下游的人也在看。
items.desc_en: Four cloth samples hang by the vat, pale to deep. The colour entered the cloth — and the people downstream are watching.
items.rules_cn: 排放与颜色实际处理；素面优先权仍按实价限一匹。
items.rules_en: Discharge and colour are handled for real; plain-cloth priority stays one bolt at real price.

items.desc_cn: 军与民各有一本点名册，同一个名字两本都在。同名不证明同人，合簿会公开家庭和病史。
items.desc_en: Military and civilian lists both carry one name. Same name is not same person, and merging the books exposes households and histories.
items.rules_cn: 两册不合并；一人一床与实给量去重。
items.rules_en: The books never merge; one person, one bed, shares counted once.

items.desc_cn: 钉在裂梁前的木牌，正面写停，背面写绕行。牌子能撤，梁不会因此接上。
items.desc_en: Nailed before the cracked beam: 'stop' on the face, 'bypass' on the back. Boards come off — beams do not mend.
items.rules_cn: 只有实做验修与复核后撤对应停牌；未验仍停。
items.rules_en: Only verified repair lifts the matching board; the rest stay.

items.desc_cn: 中立匠人做的一副短支架，只保证这一处读数用。它撑得住一架表，撑不住一整座山。
items.desc_en: A short bracket by a neutral smith, rated for this one reading. It holds an instrument — not a mountain.
items.rules_cn: 一件一次、料费不复用旧工资；差异留unknown直到可核。
items.rules_en: One piece, once, never funded from old wages; differences stay unknown until checkable.

items.desc_cn: 三刻站的原读数纸，第三格后来补过一笔。补痕看得见，误差就还在。
items.desc_en: The station's original readings, a later stroke in the third cell. The retouch is visible, so the error still stands.
items.rules_cn: 原纸与补笔分栏；复测只限本仪表，不授NE5。
items.rules_en: Original and addendum stay in separate columns; re-tests certify nothing beyond this instrument.

items.desc_cn: 商队借出的检修工具，编号刻在柄上。还回原处才算用过；卖掉就没有第二次。
items.desc_en: Tools lent by the caravan, numbers cut into the handles. Returning them is part of using them; selling forfeits the next loan.
items.rules_cn: 借还闭环；不卖、不复制、不因信任免押。
items.rules_en: Loan and return form a closed loop; no sale, no copies, no trust-based waivers.

items.desc_cn: 两块重量写死的试块，配一副低位试载架。现场能对照出来的，纸上不用猜。
items.desc_en: Two blocks of fixed weight and a low test rig. What the site can compare needs no guessing on paper.
items.rules_cn: 试件数量固定；不是无限库存，不替代实测批次。
items.rules_en: Fixed piece count; no endless stock, no substitute for tested batches.

items.desc_cn: 清单按实到人写用量，观察另开一页。碗里的水不因谁拒了签字就少一勺。
items.desc_en: Usage follows actual arrivals; observation gets its own page. A withheld signature never thins the water.
items.rules_cn: 普通分配与观察拆开；不足缩可选批，不造免费无限物。
items.rules_en: Ordinary shares and observation are split; shortages shrink optional batches, never invent free stock.

items.desc_cn: 簿子记停班时段和已核工时，页脚留着‘谁答’。工头盯不盯，都得有人在这行写字。
items.desc_en: The ledger logs stops and verified hours, a 'who answers' line at the foot. Watched or not, someone signs that line.
items.rules_cn: 已核工时只读一次；负档不夺已发工钱。
items.rules_en: Verified hours are read once; negative bands never claw back paid wages.

items.desc_cn: 木牌上写着寄存人和入窖年份，格子里空着。牌是位置，不是产权，更不是配方。
items.desc_en: A wooden tag names the keeper and the year; the rack stands empty. The tag is a place — not a title, and not a recipe.
items.rules_cn: 只存不可售；配方与代管另授权。
items.rules_en: Storage only, no sale; recipes and custody need separate leave.

items.desc_cn: 留灯驿的一盏夜灯，牌上写着留给谁。宿资照收，灯不换凭据。
items.desc_en: A night lamp at the inn, its token naming the keeper. Lodging still costs, and the lamp trades for no papers.
items.rules_cn: 一次一盏；不赊宿资、不换身份证明。
items.rules_en: One lamp, once; no credit and no identity trade.

items.desc_cn: 素面的一匹布，牌上写着优先。价钱照旧，绣样另谈，卖不卖仍看织坊。
items.desc_en: A plain bolt marked for priority. Same price, figure work separate, and the loom may still decline.
items.rules_cn: 限一匹、实价、可拒卖；不炫配方、不无限供货。
items.rules_en: One bolt, real price, refusal allowed; no recipe exposure, no endless supply.
